title: Entity Resolution Ledger (discriminated union)
description: Contradiction-preserving entity resolution. Every merge decision is reversible and requires an explicit reason code and evidence — never merged solely on similar names, shared address, shared coordinates, co-occurrence, or embedding similarity. New schema — not present in handoff-audit/phase1-design/schemas/; added per docs/spatialrag_migration/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §5 (see schemas/contracts/README.md). Discriminator: decision_type.

reason_code.description: A bare similarity score or one of the disallowed generic signals is never a valid reason_code on its own — see x-invariants.

similarity_signals.description: Informational only — never sufficient by itself to justify a merge.

x-invariants: Never merge solely because of similar names, shared address, shared coordinates, co-occurrence, or embedding similarity — reason_code must name an explicit, reviewable basis beyond those signals.
Every merge decision (entity_identity_decision.outcome == MERGE) is reversible: a later superseded_decision record can reverse it without deleting the original.
rejected_match and superseded_decision records are retained for audit, never deleted.
